title: E2EE-only servers: text/plain MUST conflicts
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 L245: supportedBodyTypes is 'MIME types accepted in bodyType' and 'MUST include "text/plain"'. An end-to-end-encrypted-only provider (mimid, decision mimid-1wgh.12.22 JM-4) never accepts plaintext, so it must either advertise a type it rejects (contradicting 'accepted') or violate the MUST. Proposed: exempt deployments that accept only encrypted body types, e.g. 'MUST include "text/plain" unless the server accepts only end-to-end encrypted body types ({{e2ee-fields}})'. Check knock-on: compliance tests, implementer guide, crate-jmap capability docs/tests that assume text/plain. Needs Mark's decision.
notes: Approved by Mark 2026-10-18: L245 becomes 'MUST include "text/plain" unless the server accepts only end-to-end encrypted body types'. Do in the post-crate-jmap-run spec pass with ka7b/3dp0/i3v4; update compliance tests; Mark commits.
